messages.subject: For Orsted executive leadership | Energy transition, government relations and stakeholder delivery
messages.body:
Dear Orsted Global Media Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before the appropriate member of Orsted senior leadership.

Orsted's international renewable-energy platform depends on trusted government relationships, permitting discipline, stakeholder confidence and clear delivery against sustainability commitments. Those priorities closely match my current executive mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across complex industrial operations and renewable-energy initiatives.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of institutional engagement, energy-transition experience and stakeholder execution could support Orsted's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Orsted.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
